Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated ferritin, low total protein, and elevated INR. There is also mild hyperchloremia and basophilia. These findings may suggest an acute or chronic inflammatory process, possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and impaired oxygenation. Further clinical correlation and investigation for underlying causes (e.g., infection, hematologic disorder, or hypoxic event) are recommended.
